description: This file contains functions related to writing and managing Git pack files, including generating index and reverse index files, handling pack headers, object headers, and temporary file creation and renaming for pack objects within a Git repository.

methods.name: void reset_pack_idx_option(struct pack_idx_option * opts)
methods.description: Initializes or resets the pack index options to default values, setting version to 2 and off32_limit to the maximum 32-bit value.

methods.name: int sha1_compare(const void * _a,const void * _b)
methods.description: Compares two pack index entries based on their SHA1 OID, used for sorting.

methods.name: int cmp_uint32(const void * a_,const void * b_)
methods.description: Compares two uint32_t values, used for binary searches.

methods.name: int need_large_offset(off_t offset,const struct pack_idx_option * opts)
methods.description: Decides if an object offset requires a large offset index, based on thresholds and anomalies.

methods.name: const char * write_idx_file(struct repository * repo,const char * index_name,struct pack_idx_entry ** objects,int nr_objects,const struct pack_idx_option * opts,const unsigned char * sha1)
methods.description: Writes a pack index (.idx) file with sorted objects, headers, and optional large offset handling.

methods.name: int pack_order_cmp(const void * va,const void * vb,void * ctx)
methods.description: Comparator for packing objects based on their offset, used to sort objects by offset.

methods.name: void write_rev_header(const struct git_hash_algo * hash_algo,struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Writes header info for a reverse index file, including signature, version, and object version.

methods.name: void write_rev_index_positions(struct hashfile * f,uint32_t * pack_order,uint32_t nr_objects)
methods.description: Writes the positional info of objects in the reverse index for pack order.

methods.name: void write_rev_trailer(const struct git_hash_algo * hash_algo,struct hashfile * f,const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Writes the SHA1 hash at the end of a reverse index file.

methods.name: char * write_rev_file(struct repository * repo,const char * rev_name,struct pack_idx_entry ** objects,uint32_t nr_objects,const unsigned char * hash,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Creates a reverse index (.rev) file for a pack, optionally verifying existing files.

methods.name: char * write_rev_file_order(struct repository * repo,const char * rev_name,uint32_t * pack_order,uint32_t nr_objects,const unsigned char * hash,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Writes the reverse index file based on a specified order of objects.

methods.name: void write_mtimes_header(const struct git_hash_algo * hash_algo,struct hashfile * f)
methods.description: Writes the header for an mtimes (.mtimes) file.

methods.name: void write_mtimes_objects(struct hashfile * f,struct packing_data * to_pack,struct pack_idx_entry ** objects,uint32_t nr_objects)
methods.description: Writes modification times for objects into the mtimes file.

methods.name: void write_mtimes_trailer(const struct git_hash_algo * hash_algo,struct hashfile * f,const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Writes the hash trailer for an mtimes file.

methods.name: char * write_mtimes_file(struct repository * repo,struct packing_data * to_pack,struct pack_idx_entry ** objects,uint32_t nr_objects,const unsigned char * hash)
methods.description: Generates an mtimes file for the pack objects.

methods.name: off_t write_pack_header(struct hashfile * f,uint32_t nr_entries)
methods.description: Writes the pack header including signature, version, and object count.

methods.name: void fixup_pack_header_footer(const struct git_hash_algo * hash_algo,int pack_fd,unsigned char * new_pack_hash,const char * pack_name,uint32_t object_count,unsigned char * partial_pack_hash,off_t partial_pack_offset)
methods.description: Re-writes the pack header with updated object count and SHA1 checksum, recalculates hash.

methods.name: char * index_pack_lockfile(struct repository * r,int ip_out,int * is_well_formed)
methods.description: Reads the lock file for an index pack operation, verifying pack name.

methods.name: int encode_in_pack_object_header(unsigned char * hdr,int hdr_len,enum object_type type,uintmax_t size)
methods.description: Encodes object type and size into a compact header for pack objects.

methods.name: struct:hashfile * create_tmp_packfile(struct repository * repo,char ** pack_tmp_name)
methods.description: Creates a temporary pack file and returns a hashfile handle.

methods.name: void rename_tmp_packfile(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * name_prefix,const char * source,const char * ext)
methods.description: Renames a temporary pack file to a final name with proper extension.

methods.name: void rename_tmp_packfile_idx(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * name_buffer,char ** idx_tmp_name)
methods.description: Renames temporary index files into final form.

methods.name: void stage_tmp_packfiles(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * name_buffer,const char * pack_tmp_name,struct pack_idx_entry ** written_list,uint32_t nr_written,struct packing_data * to_pack,struct pack_idx_option * pack_idx_opts,unsigned char hash[],char ** idx_tmp_name)
methods.description: Moves temporary pack, index, rev, and mtimes files into their proper places in the repository.

methods.name: void write_promisor_file(const char * promisor_name,struct ref ** sought,int nr_sought)
methods.description: Creates a promisor file listing objects that are promised to be available later.
